title.value: Reference panel guided topological structure annotation of Hi-C data
title.justification: The title outlines the focus of the study which involves annotating topological structures from Hi-C data using a reference panel to improve accuracy.
title.quote: Accurately annotating topological structures (e.g., loops and topologically associating domains) from Hi-C data is critical for understanding the role of 3D genome organization in gene regulation... Here, we present RefHiC, an attention-based deep learning framework that uses a reference panel of Hi- C datasets to facilitate topological structure annotation from a given study sample.

extractions.description: The paper presents RefHiC, an attention-based deep learning framework designed to annotate topological structures from Hi-C data using a reference panel to enhance prediction accuracy. The approach outperforms existing tools in loop and TAD boundary detection across various cell types and sequencing depths.
